title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Meri Taqat Mera Faisla
desc: A young man follows in his father's footsteps by working for the welfare of the people living in his district. However, a corrupt politician threatens to thwart his plans.

title: 2.O
desc: When the vengeful spirit of Pakshi Rajan wreaks havoc in the city by inexplicably sending mobile phones flying into the sky, Dr Vaseegaran enlists the help of Chitti to combat the menace.

title: Makkhi
desc: After reincarnating as a fly, a murderer decides to take revenge on his rival, who killed him, and teams up with a woman to destroy the killer's life.

title: Kasam Hindustan Ki
desc: Dhuruvan is a forest ranger who trains NCC cadets. On a trek with five college girls, he stumbles upon a gang of terrorists who plan to foil a rocket launch by ISRO.

title: Chakra Ka Rakshak
desc: A police officer and soldier team up and decide to end the cybercriminals that pose a threat to the safety of people on the Internet.
